questionSets.title: Question 1-3
questionSets.passage: The cat sat lazily in the sun, basking in its warmth. Birds chirped nearby, filling the air with their melodious songs. A gentle breeze rustled the leaves, bringing a sense of calm to the scene.
questionSets.explanation:
고양이는 햇살을 받으며 여유롭게 앉아 따뜻함을 만끽했습니다.

**[ 어휘 ]**
- rustle: 살랑살랑 흔들다

questions.title: Question 1
questions.explanation: The cat sat lazily **in the sun**, basking in its warmth.

questions.title: Question 2
questions.passage: What filled the air with sound?
questions.explanation: **Birds chirped** nearby, filling the air with their melodious songs.

questions.title: Question 3
questions.passage: What brought a sense of calm to the scene?
questions.explanation: A **gentle breeze** rustled the leaves, bringing a sense of calm to the scene.
